# Ke (Coco) Zhao

> Software engineer at Amazon (Seattle, WA) specializing in trustworthy AI agents. Leads the agent evaluation workstream and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) platform that give a multi-agent customer-service platform governed access to highly sensitive customer data; builds production AI guardrails (prompt-injection defense, PII protection, hallucination monitoring). 6+ years shipping production software, including 4 at Amazon and 2 as co-founder of ForeverBrainTech (acquired 2022); 8 peer-reviewed papers, 249+ citations. BA Computer Science & Cognitive Science, University of Pennsylvania (Magna Cum Laude, 2022); MS Cybersecurity in progress at NYU Tandon (Cyber Fellow).

## Profile
- [Personal website](https://cocozhao321.github.io/): bio, experience, selected work, publications, contact
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/coco-zhao-8555b3126/)
- [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=1sRV25IAAAAJ)

## Focus areas
- Trustworthy AI agents: evaluation, governed data access, security
- Agent evaluation: release gates, LLM-as-judge monitoring, and red-teaming for production agents
- MCP servers, tools and agent skills that give AI agents governed access to data
- Multi-agent systems on LLMs with RAG/GraphRAG
- Large-scale data platforms and real-time pipelines on AWS
- AI safety: prompt-injection defense, PII protection, hallucination monitoring
